g.text: Outdoor condenser fan — physical reconstruction lookdev
Manufacturer-neutral benchmark assumption; verify only from native 4K render. No painted highlights.
Guard wire + mount section
Ø5 mm round; 12-sided mesh section
4 × Ø15 mm formed steel feet bridge axial gap
0.5 mm controlled seat into shroud face; no floating guard
Manufacture / installation stack
1. molded casing front + 18 mm annular inlet shroud
2. recessed five-blade axial rotor, Ø330 mm assumption
3. hub on existing motor axis
4. circular guard: four rings + eight ROUND spokes, Ø5 mm wire
48 segments/ring; 12-sided wire section; no rectangular spoke strips
5. four galvanized mounting feet at r=188 mm physically seat guard to shroud
Material response
Rotor/shroud: dark dielectric polymer, metallic ≤ 0.02
Guard + mounts: aged galvanized steel, metallic response retained
Dry benchmark: wetness = 0; highlights come from light/geometry
Cause-based aging
Rotor: recessed dust + mild UV only
Shroud: UV dulling / lip rain exposure / recess dust
Guard/mounts: rain + UV + ferrous source; no arbitrary rust
LOD evidence
LOD0 full → LOD1 same wire/mount meshes → LOD2 no guard/mounts → LOD3 shroud
100% oblique/balcony_services: wire faceting, foot seating, floating read, aliasing, repetition, LOD pop.
